# What did that schedule change just cost you?

> Free fair workweek and predictive scheduling checker for restaurants and retail. Paste your posted schedule and later changes, see late postings, short-notice change premiums, cancellation pay and clopening rest violations. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
